verdict.rationale: Munito AI is mainly a hosted inference provider with EU and US regions (docs-6). A single marketing line says requests can go to Munito Compute Cloud "or to your own cloud" (docs-18), which hints at a bring-your-own-cloud deployment of the core product but gives no detail. Missing for 10: documented self-hosting or BYOC deployment guide, installable artifacts or images, clarity on which components run in the customer's environment, licensing terms for self-hosting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
